_what: COMMITTED MIRROR of public.ops_cron_ordering_contract and the schedules of the jobs it governs.
_why: ops_cron_ordering_contract declares, as DATA, that one cron job CONSUMES what another PRODUCES.
Production is enforced by mon_detect_cron_ordering_contract(), twice an hour. That detector is
correct and fails closed, but it can only speak AFTER a migration is live: a migration that
reschedules a contracted job passed every PR check, and the contract was violated that way at
~14:00Z on 2026-09-11. This mirror is the per-PR input that closes the review-time half
APPLY-AND-MIRROR IS ONE CHANGE (AGENTS.md). If you reschedule a contracted job, or add/change a
contract row, update this file in the SAME diff. scripts/verify-cron-ordering-contract.ts then
checks the gap arithmetic BEFORE the migration is applied, and its live half asserts this file
has not drifted from production's contract rows.
DO NOT fix a red check by lowering min_gap_minutes or deleting a row. The detector's own
do_not says it: fix the SCHEDULE. Lowering the floor re-creates the silent staleness the
contract exists to catch, and for this routine it is Prohibition 1 (docs/ops/BARRIER_ENGINEER.md
PART 6) — never weaken a barrier to make it green.
_semantics: gap = downstream_minute - upstream_minute, PLAIN subtraction, not modulo 60 — copied from the live detector on purpose. A consumer must trail its producer WITHIN the hour; one that runs first reads an input up to a full cycle stale. See scripts/lib/cronOrdering.ts.
_mirrored_through_migration_why: The NEWEST migration version in supabase/migrations/ whose SQL mentions ops_cron_ordering_contract. scripts/verify-cron-ordering-contract.ts recomputes this from the tree and fails if it does not match, so a migration that changes the contract without updating this file goes RED on its own PR. That is AGENTS.md's apply-and-mirror rule enforced from the diff alone — no secret, no network, and no SQL parsing. If you add such a migration, re-read production, update the rows/schedules above, and set this to the new version.
_measured_by: routine-10-barrier, via Supabase MCP against project aannarbkwcymrotzwdbo: select * from ops_cron_ordering_contract; and select jobid, jobname, schedule, active from cron.job.
